sheets.css: .s1-sheet { height: 100%; padding: 96px 72px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; } .s1-kicker { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); } h1 { font-size: 64px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; } .s1-lead { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--muted); } .s1-turn { margin-top: 48px; font-size: 20px; color: var(--accent); }

sheets.html:
Ask, then print

  1. Describe the piece.
  2. Answer three short questions.
  3. Pick a candidate.
  4. Export the PDF for the print shop.

Try it at swift.design
sheets.css: .s2-sheet { height: 100%; padding: 96px 72px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 40px; } h2 { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; } ol { padding-left: 40px; display: grid; gap: 20px; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.35; } li::marker { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; } .s2-cta { margin-top: auto; font-size: 24px; color: var(--muted); }
